description:
Plugin for Jellyfin that fetches anime themes (OPs and EDs) from animethemes.moe.
**Items are matched through their AniDB, MyAnimeList or AniList ID, so install at least one of those metadata plugins.**
name: OpEdSync
overview: Plugin for Jellyfin that fetches anime themes (OPs and EDs) from animethemes.moe

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12 support, MyAnimeList/AniList lookups, safer downloads.
